decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and close to the core B2B shop offer, so absent a clear performance shortfall the firm's slack lets it carry the plugin, though its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises some risk.
The ERP interface plugin supports the firm's end-to-end and multichannel strategy and client retention, so it likely still meets aspirations despite not being visible on the website recently.

Two sibling price comparison plugins were already withdrawn and this one has not appeared on the website since 2019, which suggests results below aspiration, so problemistic search points to moving its resources to the core business and newer platform development.

The net price reporting plugin complements Product A at low cost, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 suggests weak attention, so a withdrawal is a real possibility even though keeping it remains more likely.
